body:
## What to build

Report a duplicate Grouping set already guaranteed by a Cartesian product prefix before acquiring metadata for a trailing single-set selection.

## Evidence

On main `7a05a1e42d53af62c057a30ad1892ffb35d4eef8`, use a Cartesian product of a grouping-set union with two occurrences of a and a trailing `where()` selection. Each equal prefix occurrence unions with the same single set, so positions 1 and 2 are duplicates under the error policy. DuckDB sends a selection-proxy metadata query and calls the predicate before diagnosing the duplicate. An unsafe derived dtplyr step reports the typed-metadata refusal instead. Replacing the trailing selection with a bare column reports the duplicate immediately. The repaired leading duplicate inside a single `grouping_sets()` also reports it immediately.

ADR 0005 governs known errors before backend reads. #1228 and #1246 covered completed duplicate occurrences within a union. This reproduction reaches a Cartesian product before the trailing factor has resolved.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Inspection and Margin summary calls report the guaranteed duplicate with the correct occurrence positions before the trailing predicate runs or typed metadata is acquired.
- [ ] A product without a proven duplicate still resolves its typed selector and reports any duplicate discovered afterward.
- [ ] Preserve drop and keep policies, leading selection errors and occurrence order.

## Blocked by

None.
title: [P2] Refuse guaranteed product duplicates before typed Grouping metadata
